name: Manifold
role: Fast mesh Booleans (CSG) with guaranteed watertight output, in Node/WASM or Python
summary: Manifold (manifold-3d on npm, manifold3d on PyPI) unions, subtracts and intersects triangle meshes and guarantees a manifold result, with volume, genus and status queries. In Node it runs as WASM from one pnpm dependency. It is not a CAD kernel: no fillets, no STEP.
use_when: Mesh Booleans on triangle geometry, over build123d when B-rep and STEP are not needed
A watertight result must be certified numerically before it enters a 3D scene
Boolean work in Node or a browser, where trimesh would need an external engine
avoid_when: Dimensioned parts with fillets or STEP export: build123d
Inspecting or converting mesh files: trimesh or gltf-transform
notes: 2026-11-27: lead said 3.5.5 on PyPI and npm; npm 3.5.5 confirmed at install. Python manifold3d and glTF export were not exercised.
2026-11-27: thread-count determinism (TBB builds) untested; the npm WASM build ran single-threaded.

assessment.rationale: Apache-2.0, active (push 2026-11-26), installs with pnpm and ran without system software. Fills the triangle-mesh Boolean gap beside build123d (B-rep), trimesh (external engines) and fogleman-sdf (implicit).

evidence.result: cube(2) minus sphere(r1.2, 64 seg): NoError, genus 5, 812 verts, 1640 tris, volume 1.638331 from raw arrays equals volume(); 0 unpaired and 0 repeated edges; V(A-B) and V(A+B) inclusion-exclusion residual 1.8e-15; analytic 1.616284 (1.364% faceting gap); identical bytes across processes; 600x600 still inspected.
evidence.scope: One cube-minus-sphere Boolean in Node 22 WASM on macOS arm64; not Python, glTF export, loaded meshes, threads or timing.
